victor-harbor-9.name: Kleinigs Hill Lookout
victor-harbor-9.bio: Lookout on Hindmarsh Road over Victor Harbor and Granite Island, with a telescope and a mosaic whale called Kondoli.
victor-harbor-9.ticket_note: Council-run open lookout with no operator site (council page is bot-blocked).
victor-harbor-9.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag for Kleinigs Hill Lookout (Hindmarsh Road); OSM/Overpass unavailable so only one source, LOW
notes: pin LOW: single tourism-board geotag; Commons photo median is 1 km NE; verify on a map
Free per City of Victor Harbor via search summary; council page bot-blocked

victor-harbor-10.name: Newland Head Conservation Park
victor-harbor-10.bio: Conservation park on the Fleurieu's south coast with Waitpinga and Parsons beaches, cliff walks and views to Kangaroo Island.
victor-harbor-10.coordinates_source: NPWS SA park page: Waitpinga campground point (park's main visitor point), agrees with Commons photo at -35.62772,138.50065 (80 m); not the OSM reserve centroid
notes: NPWS page lists fees as accommodation only (campsites from $13.30 per night); no vehicle entry fee shown, so free/open. Beaches not suitable for swimming.
Closed on days of Catastrophic Fire Danger.

victor-harbor-11.name: Middleton
victor-harbor-11.bio: A coastal village east of Port Elliot with a surf beach and a rocky point on the Fleurieu coast.
victor-harbor-11.ticket_note: Open village and beach with no single steward.
notes: Draft bio's 'old winery' dropped: only a farm-stay listing named The Old Middleton Winery found, no public cellar door.
Southern right whales reported off Middleton Point June to October (one travel site only), left out of bio.

victor-harbor-12.name: Victor Harbor National Trust Museum
victor-harbor-12.bio: Heritage museum in an 1866 house at Victor Harbor, with period rooms and displays on the town's colonial history.
victor-harbor-12.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag for the museum (Flinders Parade); single source, LOW
notes: pin LOW: single tourism-board geotag, OSM unavailable
Adult $6 (concession $5, child $4, family $16, National Trust members free) from the museum's own site. Volunteer-run, open about 11am-3pm Wednesday to Monday, daily in school and public holidays.

victor-harbor-13.name: Glacier Rock
victor-harbor-13.bio: Permian glacial pavement in the Inman River bed, with ice-scratched bedrock first recorded by a geologist in 1859.
victor-harbor-13.ticket_note: Open natural site; no operator site.
victor-harbor-13.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag for Glacier Rock, agrees within ~50 m with the Wikipedia coordinates for Selwyn's Rock (-35.4965, 138.5124) as quoted by a search summary
notes: The draft hint (-35.49526,138.454944) is the Inman Valley locality centroid, 5 km west of the rock; not used.
wiki omitted: 'Selwyn's Rock' only redirects to the Inman Valley locality article.
Site is in the river bed below a cafe on Inman Valley Road (address given as 1 Mount Alma Road).

victor-harbor-14.name: Hindmarsh River Walking Trail
victor-harbor-14.bio: Easy river walk near Victor Harbor through paperbark woodland and past a lagoon, with birdlife along the way.
victor-harbor-14.ticket_note: Council-managed open trail; the visitor-board page is not an operator site.
victor-harbor-14.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag (trail start area near Bridge Terrace), NOT the route midpoint
notes: pin LOW: trailhead-area point, route midpoint not resolved (OSM unavailable); raise to owner to midpoint the route
Length reported as 4, 7 or 8 km depending on source; start at end of Bridge Terrace or McCracken Picnic Area; five stages 30 min to 3 hours.

victor-harbor-15.name: Inman River Trail
victor-harbor-15.bio: Flat riverside walk from Muwerang (Kent Reserve) with a bird hide, ending at Victor Harbor Cemetery.
victor-harbor-15.ticket_note: Council-managed open trail; no operator site.
victor-harbor-15.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag for the Inman River Trail, NOT the route midpoint
notes: pin LOW: single tourism-board geotag, route midpoint not resolved (OSM unavailable); raise to owner
About 8 km, flat; Clydesdales of the Horse Drawn Tram can be seen near the route.

goolwa-1.name: Strathalbyn
goolwa-1.bio: Scottish-founded town on the Angas River with heritage streets and St Andrew's Church, inland from Goolwa.
goolwa-1.ticket_note: Open town with no single steward.
goolwa-1.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com Strathalbyn destination point (town centre), within 250 m of the OSM boundary node -35.2576,138.8957
notes: Antiques-shops claim in the draft bio is from a generic listing only, dropped.
Founded 1839 by Scottish settlers (dates vary by source).

goolwa-2.name: Goolwa Barrage
goolwa-2.bio: Walk halfway across the barrage that holds back the sea from the Murray, with a picnic area and signs.
goolwa-2.ticket_note: Government-managed open structure; no operator site.
notes: Entry free; board listing gives hours 8.30-12.30 and 1.30-4.30 daily, another source 8-5.30: not stored. Reached from the Goolwa side by Barrage Road, no access from Hindmarsh Island.
Seals and pelicans are often seen.

goolwa-3.name: Signal Point Experience Centre
goolwa-3.bio: Wharf-side gallery and interpretive centre in Goolwa on Indigenous and colonial heritage and the Murray Mouth.
goolwa-3.ticket_note: Steward is Alexandrina Council; its page returned a bot wall, see needs_browser. visitalexandrina.com is the tourism site, not used.
goolwa-3.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag (1 Laurie Lane), matches the median of geotagged Commons files at the wharf (-35.50338,138.78555)
notes: Free entry per the tourism-board listing; gallery open Wednesday to Sunday 10am-4pm per Visit Alexandrina (not stored).

goolwa-4.name: Goolwa Beach
goolwa-4.bio: Surf beach east of Goolwa with a car park, kiosk and surf club, and a vehicle track to the Murray Mouth.
goolwa-4.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com listing geotag, at the car park/beach entrance by the surf club; Wikipedia's point (-35.51353,138.76975) is ~1 km north on the dunes/beach
notes: pin LOW-ish: one geotag plus Wikipedia disagreeing by 1 km; chose the car park/entrance where visitors stand
Vehicles not allowed on the beach west of the access track; 40 km/h limit; sand dunes off limits; 4WD rules may change.

goolwa-5.name: Hindmarsh Island
goolwa-5.bio: Island across the bridge from Goolwa, with a lookout over the Murray Mouth where waders and pelicans gather.
goolwa-5.ticket_note: Island with many operators; no single official site.
goolwa-5.coordinates_source: southaustralia.com Hindmarsh Island destination point (island village); Wikipedia's -35.5167,138.8667 is the island's centre and was not used
notes: pin LOW: single tourism-board point; the Murray Mouth lookout (the main draw) is further SE and not pinned.
Bridge opened 2001.

destination.name: Goolwa
destination.tagline: A river-port town where the Murray meets the sea, with a barrage and a wharf precinct.
destination.description: Goolwa sits on the lower Murray where the river meets Lake Alexandrina, a few kilometres from the Southern Ocean. A series of barrages holds back the sea, and you can walk halfway across the Goolwa Barrage. The wharf precinct has an interpretive centre on the Murray Mouth, and a bridge leads to Hindmarsh Island and its waterbirds. A surf beach runs south-east of town, and Strathalbyn and Langhorne Creek are an easy drive inland.
whyVisit: Walk out across the Murray barrage
Watch waterbirds near the Murray Mouth

goodToKnow.title: Barrage access is from Goolwa
goodToKnow.detail: Reach the barrage by Barrage Road from the Goolwa side. There is no way onto it from Hindmarsh Island.

goodToKnow.title: Check beach driving rules
goodToKnow.detail: Four-wheel drives use the track behind the surf club, best at low tide with tyres lowered. Rules change, so check with the council.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Visit in {months} for mild days on the river and beach. Summer is hotter and winter is wetter.

notes: Coordinates: southaustralia.com Goolwa destination point -35.50289,138.78373 (town centre), 190 m from the Signal Point pin; Wikipedia's -35.5,138.7667 is a rounded point.
Span kept at 60 km: Strathalbyn ~29 km, Langhorne Creek ~32 km, Tolderol ~36 km from the centre, all inside 75% (45 km).

Order changed: Goolwa's own barrage, Signal Point, beach and Hindmarsh Island first, then Strathalbyn, Goolwa Motor Museum, Langhorne Creek, Gilbert's Motor Museum, Strathalbyn museum, Animal Farm, Tolderol. Ids unchanged.

Gilbert's Motor Museum is in Strathalbyn (34 High Street, adult $10), not Goolwa; Goolwa Motor Museum is at 45 Gardiner St (shard 4 to confirm). Strathalbyn Districts Museum is a second Strathalbyn museum.

Facts: Hindmarsh Island bridge, barrage walk and Murray Mouth birds (Visit Alexandrina, board, Wikivoyage); beach vehicle rules (Fleurieu news, 4WD guides). Rank 4: 3 reasons, 2 tips.
